home.howItWorks.step1.body: Browse a curated roster of licensed practitioners. Filter by specialty, language, and same-day availability in your district.
home.howItWorks.step2.title: Schedule the appointment
home.howItWorks.step2.body: Hotel suite, private residence, or villa anywhere in central Bangkok. Sessions of 60 to 120 minutes, arranged with discretion.
home.howItWorks.step3.title: Restore in your sanctuary
home.howItWorks.step3.body: Your therapist arrives fully equipped. Settle the booking securely, share a private review, and re-book your preferred practitioner with a single tap.

home.faq.arrival.q: How quickly can a therapist arrive?
home.faq.arrival.a: Average arrival is under 60 minutes anywhere in central Bangkok. Live ETA shown at booking.
home.faq.licensed.a: Yes — every practitioner holds a current Thai Ministry of Public Health licence () and is recertified annually.
home.faq.equipment.a: Yes. Therapists arrive with portable table, fresh linens, oils, and amenities.
home.faq.hotels.a: Most central Bangkok hotels including Mandarin Oriental, Anantara, Park Hyatt, St. Regis, and serviced residences.
home.faq.payments.a: Pay in-app with card, WeChat Pay, AliPay, PromptPay, or cash on arrival. No tipping required.
home.faq.languages.a: English, 中文, 日本語, 한국어, and ไทย — both in-app and via 24/7 multilingual concierge.
home.finalCta.body: 32 therapists online now. Average arrival time under one hour anywhere in central Bangkok.
